S-02C finding-status claims remain bounded to durable status distinction preservation and do not substitute for S-03 interpretation, S-02B execution, or bottom-up pipeline truth.
Missing or malformed legacy probe logs degrade safely without failing the existing pipeline.
allowed_to_churn: Finding-status snapshot details may sharpen while preserving status, boundary, function, args, result excerpt, and trace reviewability.
Status persistence fixtures may grow one S-02C breakpoint family at a time.

systems.description: Owns the cheap governance proof that live stage truth, trace markers, blocker-family docs, stage-split doctrine, and migration audit role surfaces stay synchronized.
durable_contracts: Every numbered pipeline stage keeps the required sticky doc set.
Stage README runtime owner files are represented in TRACE.md with red/yellow/gray/green context.
Stage live contracts expose semantic obligation, handoff rules, advance/stay/fail posture, compatibility notes, and blocker-family awareness.
Stage-split and migration audit doctrine remains connected to live stage truth without claiming runtime proof.
allowed_to_churn: Stage doc wording may evolve as long as required headings and ownership markers remain.
Migration doctrine may add examples while preserving the live-truth versus architecture-doctrine boundary.

systems.description: Owns session snapshot and route surfaces that expose handoff packet truth to API consumers.
durable_contracts: Session routes preserve snapshot and handoff packet fields needed by operators.
Route-level packet reads remain deterministic and do not require heavy suite execution.
Route tests catch schema breakage before runtime regression gates.
allowed_to_churn: Response payloads may add fields when old fields remain readable.
Route implementation may move while preserving API-facing packet semantics.

systems.description: Owns save-session and blob-only checkpoint artifact materialization used by hosted/local regression gates.
durable_contracts: Blob-only captures preserve route-equivalent packet and legacy artifact visibility.
Session manifests identify emitted versus recovered artifacts.
Key checkpoint artifacts remain reviewable without requiring a live API snapshot route.
allowed_to_churn: Additional artifacts may be materialized when old aliases remain readable.
Manifest metadata may become richer when existing origin/source fields remain stable.

systems.description: Owns worker-side persistence of invocables and route-visible run evidence.
durable_contracts: Worker persistence writes invocable evidence in the expected durable location.
Persistence failures remain observable through focused tests before suite gates.
Worker state changes do not silently break route/session consumers.
allowed_to_churn: Persistence internals may change while preserving artifact and route contracts.
Additional persisted fields may be added.

systems.description: Owns Codex operating law, specialist dispatch doctrine, and dynamic-campaign governance contracts.
durable_contracts: Agent governance changes remain auditable by the governance audit.
Dynamic-campaign and dispatch laws do not silently contradict registry-backed check roles.
Governance-only changes stay on the cheap floor unless mixed with runtime changes.
allowed_to_churn: Prompt doctrine and role wording may evolve as long as auditability is preserved.
Specialist-role lifecycle metadata may change under explicit governance updates.
